Releases

Release notes

Every Rest Hippo release since 1.0.0, newest first, with one line for each change that went into it. Each change links to its commit, and each release to its page on GitHub Releases, where its installers are. The latest version is always on the download page.

v1.19.0 2026-08-10Release on GitHub →

The version jumps from 1.1.5 to 1.19.0 to pass the Microsoft Store's published 1.18.4.0 package, putting GitHub, the Mac App Store and the Microsoft Store on one ascending version line.

  • ac8ee4bRedirected 'Other Hippos' to 'Visit the hippo herd'
  • 0abd0c6Tinted the site purple

v1.1.5 2026-07-30Release on GitHub →

  • 4a37c65Added claude code link to website
  • 5961510Added 'Other Hippos' link
  • cd643afUpdated build packages
  • 6061c85Added language guard and alloed ESC to close variable editor
  • 9f620c7Various UI tweaks

v1.1.4 2026-07-15Release on GitHub →

  • b2d05a7Fixed the release workflow's Microsoft Store submit step, which now skips itself until the Store is configured instead of failing the run.
  • 34d507fHardening
  • aee818eAdded support for capturing variable values in the timeline
  • b24b2d7Finished the rebrand to Rest Hippo in the icon build script, and committed two Prettier line reflows.
  • d4f8dcdHarden IPC boundary: validate path-segment ids + cap import reads
  • 57ba55dHardened encryption: the master password now derives its key with memory-hard scrypt, and a backup uses one key for all its secrets instead of one per secret, so export and import no longer freeze the UI. Existing secrets and backups stay readable.
  • a52f09fFixed a stray NUL byte in an IPC store test that made git treat the file as binary, replacing it with genuinely forbidden ids.
  • a643fffAdded a test suite for the Settings window, until now the largest untested part of the UI.
  • 29e7991Moved the save-coalescing loop and the response cache out of app.js into their own unit-tested modules, with no change in behaviour.
  • cf9a3b1Adding support files for tracking
  • 3b79fddSave Point
  • 5ae12a5Fixed e2e testing
